title: Secrets of Strixhaven | A Living Flame

entities.name: Rootha Squallheart
entities.description: A Prismari senior at Strixhaven and one of the five Champions who drove the Phyrexians from campus; she is haunted by her failure in the invocation and creates the Living Flame.

entities.name: Dean Nassari
entities.description: A djinni dean of Prismari and Rootha's former advisor, who is made of flame and uses they/them pronouns.

entities.name: Phyrexian Nassari
entities.description: The half-compleated, metal-fleshed version of Dean Nassari who taunted Rootha during the invocation in the Biblioplex.

entities.name: Glassyk
entities.description: A young Prismari elf and prodigy who saves Rootha with a thread of magic and later loses control of the elemental whale he was channeling.

entities.name: Kahri
entities.description: A human wind mage in Prismari, known as the one-woman band, who is Rootha's friend.

entities.name: Lux
entities.description: A drunk human guy with an ocean-blue tattoo who tells Justice that Rootha is a Champion of Strixhaven.

entities.name: Justice
entities.description: A solid, long-haired orc and Lux's boyfriend who had a planar history class with Rootha and missed the invasion.

entities.name: Quint
entities.description: A quiet boy from Lorehold who shored up the invocation when Rootha faltered and later became a planeswalker.

entities.name: The Living Flame
entities.description: A sphere of red and orange wild magic that Rootha made and holds under control of her will; it gives off no heat.

entities.name: The Elemental Whale
entities.description: An enormous cerulean humpback whale construct of elemental magic from the Whale Trench that goes out of control and floods the gallery.

entities.name: Euphony Gorge
entities.description: A gorge at the site of Summitfest.

entities.name: Summitfest
entities.description: A three-week festival of spellcasting at Spectacle Summit with a showcase at month's end.

entities.name: The Whale Trench
entities.description: A narrow fissure in the mountains through which elemental whales migrate.

entities.name: The Muse
entities.description: An enormous stone woman overlooking the mountainside, rumored to be a rock formation.

entities.name: Spectacle Summit
entities.description: The mountaintop where Summitfest and the gallery are held.

entities.name: The Gallery
entities.description: A cluster of wagons and caravans at the edge of Spectacle Summit where artisans trade and sell.

entities.name: The Biblioplex
entities.description: The Strixhaven library where the five students performed the invocation against the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: The school where Rootha studies.

entities.name: Prismari
entities.description: The Strixhaven college of elemental artistry that Rootha, Nassari, Kahri and Glass belong to.

entities.name: Lorehold
entities.description: A Strixhaven college that Quint belonged to.

entities.name: The Machine Orthodoxy
entities.description: The Phyrexian order that Phyrexian Nassari served.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The invaders who attacked Rootha's home plane and Strixhaven.

entities.name: The Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian attack on Arcavios that bisected Rootha's time at Strixhaven.

entities.name: The Night of Flame
entities.description: The night Rootha and Nassari's combined flames destroyed the rogue elemental whale, later a Summitfest tradition.

events.summary: At sunrise, Rootha, shaken by a night terror, sees Dean Nassari on the ridge and tries to flee.
events.quote: Dean Nassari stands precariously on a slender jut of rock.

events.summary: Rootha slips from the ridge as the edge gives way, and a thread of magic yanks her to safety.
events.quote: A single thread of magic loops around my wrists and yanks me up.

events.summary: Rootha meets Glass, who saved her, as he channels magic into a whale for his capstone project.
Rootha returns to camp and tells Kahri about her fall; Kahri says everyone knows Glass is a savant.
Rootha reveals the Living Flame, which she has finished and shown to no one, and is pulled into a memory of the Biblioplex.
events.quote: I call it the Living Flame, and it's the greatest thing I've ever made.

events.summary: At the gallery, Rootha meets Lux and Justice, who learn she is a Champion who helped drive off the Phyrexians; she flees.
events.quote: She was one of the five students who performed the invocation to drive the Phyrexians from campus.

events.summary: Rootha bumps into Kahri and Dean Nassari appears, but does not look at Rootha.
events.quote: Nassari stands right there and doesn't look at me once.

events.summary: The rogue elemental whale appears and floods the gallery with water.
events.quote: An enormous cerulean whale, turned black in the dying evening light, swollen with magic and careening out of control across the summit.

events.summary: Rootha recognizes Glass inside the whale; Nassari concludes he has lost control.
Nassari's flames cut off the whale's limbs, but they grow back, and the boiling water endangers the crowd.
events.quote: a jet of flame escapes Nassari's palm

events.summary: Flashback to the Biblioplex invocation, where the Phyrexian Nassari taunts Rootha and she loses concentration.
Flashback: Quint shores up the casting, saving the others, and later becomes a planeswalker.
events.quote: The only reason any of us survive is because of Quint, a quiet boy from Lorehold.

events.summary: Rootha summons the Living Flame to lend Nassari more force, and takes Nassari's offered hand.
events.quote: I take Dean Nassari's hand, and the world around us turns to fire.

events.summary: Their combined flames destroy the elemental whale in the Night of Flame, and nobody is seriously hurt.
events.quote: Shockingly, beyond a few burns and scrapes, no one was hurt that night.

events.summary: Nassari apologizes for neglecting Rootha and what they said in the Biblioplex, and offers to be her advisor.
events.quote: You aren't looking for an advisor still, are you?

events.summary: Rootha helps Nassari to their feet, accepting the reconciliation.
events.quote: This time, I reach out a hand and pull them to theirs.

relations.note: Nassari was Rootha's advisor and offers to be so again.
relations.quote: I know, technically, I haven't been yours in years

relations.note: Kahri is Rootha's friend who pulls her out of her room.
Glass saves Rootha from the fall.
relations.quote: "I'm glad that Glassyk was there to catch you!"
This must be the boyfriend he mentioned a few times.

relations.note: Phyrexian Nassari acts in service to the Machine Orthodoxy.
relations.quote: everything they do is in service to the Machine Orthodoxy.
I remember the early days of Prismari

relations.note: Quint covered for Rootha's failure in the invocation, and they were two of the five Champions.
relations.quote: He compensates for my failure, shoring up the casting.
